reference_semantics.meaning: TTIR real semantics G and its enclosure (Welford merge, SumK / DotK accumulation, upstream-source detection)

statistics.value: frozen decision layer + numeric contract v3 cannot-judge rules (S0 = 2, N0 = 64, n_min = 16)

versions.result_schemas: each report carries tool_version; unified-entry reports carry expanded_declaration and declaration_sha256

recommended.what_it_does: declare call + input sources + comparison + budget; the tool expands default rules, builds the reference, runs the statistics and classifies failures

captured_packages.use: launches captured in another environment, analysed in ka_main (historical declarations under results/reference_eval/declarations)

entry_points.same_statistics: all three entries use analysis.assess_units; the unified entry adds Holm within each rule class and the contract_v3 cannot-judge rules

capability.supported: single Triton kernels whose outputs Triton writes and whose operations are in the rule registry: numerical difference (mode A, e_num = K - G) with mean-effect statistics in two rule classes; mode B (e_sem = G - f) where a spec exists and the output reads no non-Triton intermediate
not_supported: block pointers / TMA descriptors (tt.make_tensor_ptr, tt.advance, descriptors)
tt.cat, histogram, atomic_cas, bit counting, unregistered libdevice symbols or inline asm
outputs written by cuBLAS / ATen (no reference)
saved values, backward and optimizer writes as one automated call graph
known_limits: adaptive working precision not implemented (cancellation in 1 + erf / tanh leaves about 6% of activation elements above 1/8 ulp)
bounded route only in the calibration, not applied by the entry
the unified entry imports scripts/essential/contract_v3.py: a non-editable wheel does not ship it (packaging issue, PR-B)

common_not_established.semantics missing: an operation or combine region outside the registry (see the rule registry report)
common_not_established.binding: the output is written by a non-Triton op, the pairing is not provable, or the call rejected the declared inputs
common_not_established.enclosure too wide / statistics insuffic: the reference cannot resolve the effect scale, or the sample cannot support a mean statement (zero variance, n < 16, skewness > 2 with n <= 64)

acceptance.state: measured under frozen rules, not scored: package ISSUER_RESEAL_REQUIRED

history.stage_summary_20261002: docs/stage_summary_20261002.md (historical baseline; superseded where the documents above say so)

test_policy: tests must not modify or rewrite tracked files (tests/conftest.py guard); outputs go to tmp_path
